bra: Every brief carries "No store name, no URL, no logo" and "No free shipping, Klarna, returns or delivery time — store policy differs between the two stores" — the only hub of seven that writes the mirroring rule down, and it is the right rule for a hub that mirrors into CaraShell.
Price is right everywhere (1 129 / 1 469 kr) and `från 1 129 kr` is used whenever the nine sizes are named — the 13,5 m size costs 2 239 kr, so a bare price would have lied.
Nine sizes verified: the page carries 9 variants live; PD_10_1 quotes the strap facts exactly as the page states them (straps on all four sides, 2,5 m, adjustable).
PD_10_H1 is a clean one-variable test against a named parent (PD_2_H1, hook only) and PD_10_1 is its static twin — that is how a variable gets isolated.
CS_12_H1 and CS_13_1 point at the parent fact (the CS price anchor, CS_2_1) instead of inventing a new angle; CS_13_1 changes the unit (58 kr/m²) exactly as copy-regler describes.
missat: CS_12_H1 and PD_10_H1 say `spänns fast med rem och dragsko i kanten` — the page says straps on all four sides hooked into a hook at the bottom edge, plus two 10,5 m ratchet straps; there is no drawstring (read live from the product page 2026-09-21; CaraShell removed the same claim 2026-09-12). The editor would film a part that does not exist.

CO_5_H1 opens on `Det har ju gått bra hittills.` — nothing to picture, and any cover brand can sign it. The brief's own three-question table marks it Pass; so does every other line in the round (48 of 48) — the test is decorative here.

CS_13_1: `1 129 kr för 19,5 m² – hela takytan på en 6,5-meters husvagn` — 6,5 × 3 m is the cover, not the roof; the edge hangs 30–40 cm down the sides, so the roof is smaller than 19,5 m². Say the fabric area, not `takytan`.

BOF_8_1 and OB_2_H1 build a whole concept on the storage bag. It IS on Bäverbutiken's page (`ryms i medföljande förvaringspåse`), but CaraShell's dna.md forbids the claim (supplier images never show a bag) — these two mirror into CaraShell carrying a claim that store decided not to make. Owner's call before the mirror runs.

GT_10_H1: valid for Bäverbutiken (GT_2_H1 carries 24 purchases there), but CaraShell's dna.md pattern 12 says no GT briefs until the inherited GT_2_H1 is recreated in its own test ABO — the mirror will drop this one into a CBO that has starved GT (611 kr, 0 purchases). Hold it at the mirror.

`Taket är det du aldrig ser – och det som kostar mest att laga.` is the carrying line in 4 of 11 briefs (BOF_9_1, CO_5_H1, CS_13_1, GT_10_H1). When four concepts share the payoff line, the data cannot tell the concepts apart.

TR_3_H1 states a fact about competitors (`Ett helöverdrag … skaver mot lacken hela vintern`) with no source — falsifiable and unverified; the honest version is what THIS cover does (one person, roof only).

No Variables line on any brief; 8 of 11 concepts have no source named (parent ad, playbook, swipe or "guess"); no COPY CARD. PD_10_H1's hook is two sentences plus a price — too long for the first second.
regler: Every mechanism line is read from the product page the same day: this page says straps on all four sides, 2,5 m, adjustable, hooked into a hook at the bottom edge, plus two 10,5 m ratchet straps — never `dragsko`, never a part the page does not name.

Run the three-question test for real on the hook: a line any cover brand could sign (`Det har ju gått bra hittills`) or a line you cannot picture is a ❌ and is rewritten before the brief goes out — a table with 48 passes is not a test.

Add a Variables line (angle · hook · format · proof · offer · visual · text · speaker) to every brief and name the source in the Why (parent ad with CPA and purchases, playbook, swipe, or "guess") — and check products/carashell/takskyddet/dna.md before briefing anything that mirrors: no storage bag, no GT until the GT_2_H1 test ABO exists.
